opus.problem: The herdsmen's quarrel is in Genesis 13:7-8, not in the cited verses 13:10-11. The reference should be widened to Genesis 13:7-11.
'Four kings' does not appear in the cited verses 14:12-16, which say only 'They'. The four kings are named in Genesis 14:9, so the reference should be widened to include it.

The wife who looked back and became a pillar of salt is one of the most famous details in Genesis, and 'Lot's wife' is a well-known phrase. This clue nearly gives the answer away on its own, so it is not medium hard.
